jobs.location: New Jersey - New York City Metro - Remote
jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category
Customer Success
Job Details

About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Health & Life Sciences Program Manager is a senior, executive-facing individual contributor (IC) within the Global Life Sciences Acceleration Hub of Salesforce Professional Services. As an IC, Program Managers hold no direct reports, and yet expertly advise large numbers of our most senior talent across our most complex customer engagements: multi-workstream transformations, strategic accounts, and enterprise implementations where the margin for error is narrow and the consequences of failure are visible at the C-suite.

The Program Manager is engaged across a portfolio of accounts in short-term advisory capacities, providing SME oversight on governance, program management discipline, escalation handling, and risk monitoring. They advise and support Program Execs and delivery teams already on the ground, strengthening governance rigor, surfacing risk, and coaching through escalations. They facilitate and actively participate in Steering Committees and other key governance forums, ensuring disciplined cadence, effective decision-making, and executive alignment across the accounts they advise. For smaller accounts without existing program management roles from Salesforce Professional Services, the role engages for a temporary, defined period to stand up the program, establishing governance structures, instilling program monitoring and risk mitigation processes and cadences, and then transitions ongoing program management to the SI partner, ensuring continuity before stepping back. The ideal candidate will bring a diverse IT and/or Management Consulting background and knowledge of Health & Life Sciences industry trends, leveraging this credibility as a strategic advisor to our customers, partners, and internal teams across Salesforce. The candidate will be able to craft innovative, forward-looking strategies while clearly defining the path forward, leading the changes to IT strategy, policies, processes, people, governance and partnerships, and translate program delivery into measurable business outcomes.

Health & Life Science Program Managers advise and support cross-functional teams deploying cutting-edge digital workforces that bridge the gap between complex biomedical data and actionable healthcare insights, driving the next frontier of life sciences innovation, while leveraging AI tools and agentic workflows themselves to accelerate governance reviews, risk monitoring, and program health tracking across the portfolio of accounts they oversee.

Their success is defined by what they deliver, what they prevent, and the customer confidence they command.

Your Impact

AI and agentic delivery are embedded in how you work: you actively leverage AI tooling and agentic workflows to optimize how your program teams deliver. You reduce manual overhead, accelerate insight, and model the productivity gains customers are investing in Salesforce to achieve.

Engagement Success is well-defined and honored: you assess and strengthen the program strategy, management approach, and governance structures already in place, advising the accountable Program Exec/delivery lead, and align on the objectives and outcomes of the engagement as well as the KPIs to measure its success.

Customer outcomes strengthened through accountable advisory support: you act as a trusted SME advisor to the executive-facing delivery owner, strengthening governance, risk visibility, and escalation handling, without displacing the accountable Program Exec if one is assigned to the program. You will advise Program Execs and manage communications within Salesforce up to the CxO level regarding expectations, program performance, governance, and issue escalation and resolution during the course of delivery. You earn trust through consistently-accurate forecasting, honest risk communication, and follow-through.

The delivery team performs at a higher level because you're in it: you effectively lead, inspire, and uplift Salesforce Professional Services team members — coaching them to perform at a higher level while contributing to the internal processes, artifacts, and methodologies that raise the floor for service delivery across our most strategic accounts. What you learn and implement travels.

The full engagement is yours to guide: you are accountable for overseeing and improving the quality of end-to-end service delivery and ensure program risk is identified and managed effectively. You help protect bid-versus-delivered margin on the accounts you advise by surfacing risk and governance gaps early.

Value delivered translates into real adoption and consumption: you drive the transformational changes, especially around AI and agentic capabilities, needed to achieve customers' objectives, informed by deep industry and product expertise. You align IT strategy, governance, processes, and stakeholder decisions to ensure system satisfaction, adoption, and consumption directly deliver profound customer impact.

Risk is managed before it manages you: you anticipate, mitigate, and manage risk to Salesforce and the customer, taking decisive program action to address risk profiles ensuring every customer achieves successful desired outcomes. You raise signals with a recommended path, not just a problem statement. Surfacing a risk is success; being surprised by one is not.

White space becomes pipeline and internal alignment sustains it: you proactively build and expand business relationships which enable Salesforce to support, transform and win business that delivers mutual value, working hand in hand with Sales, Success, Technology & Product, and Support to drive customer adoption initiatives and maintain alignment as One Salesforce. You ensure alignment with Sales and develop multi-threaded executive relationships within accounts to accelerate value and improve customer outcomes. Delivery-originated pipeline is a portfolio metric, and you are one of its primary sources.

Minimum Requirements

Demonstrated experience applying AI productivity tools, automation, or agentic workflows within a professional services or program delivery context. Able to articulate measurable impact on delivery efficiency, team output, or customer outcomes

12+ years of professional services or consulting delivery experience, ith deep expertise in program execution across financials, risk, scope, and customer outcomes, applied in an advisory or delivery-leadership capacity

Demonstrated track record leading large, complex programs ($10M+) with measurable outcomes that have positively impacted the business

5+ years leading large, cross-functional delivery teams across multiple geographies and workstreams, with the ability to lead both direct and indirect team members, including third-party system integrators, without positional authority

Direct experience managing program financials at the engagement level, including forecasting to budget, financial management, revenue control, earned value analysis, contingency management, and delivered-versus-bid margin

End-to-end knowledge of the concepts, practices, procedures, and deliverables associated with system development, implementation, and operational readiness, including the ability to partner with technical teams on comprehensive operational planning and address technical issues as they arise

Proven ability to lead steering committee and executive-level customer relationships, including the ability to conduct difficult data-driven conversations around budget, resources, timelines, and formal outcomes and drive decisions under pressure

Demonstrated ability to operate across multiple concurrent accounts/engagements simultaneously, context-switching between short-term advisory assignments and longer-term SME oversight roles

Experience conducting structured sales-to-delivery handoffs or equivalent intake processes that establish delivery from a position of clarity. Every project starts with context, confirmed scope, and named risk, not rediscovery

Demonstrated ability to identify and escalate delivery risk proactively with clear examples of surfacing issues early enough to course-correct outcomes before they reach the customer

Ability to collaborate effectively across global time zones and geographies.

Outstanding executive presence and communication skills, verbal and written, including the ability to lead high-powered workshops and effectively tailor messaging based on audience

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience delivering Agentforce or equivalent AI platform implementations at the enterprise level. Ability to credibly advise customers on agentic enterprise transformations.

PMP, PgMP, or SAFe certification, or equivalent demonstrated program management discipline applied at scale across long-duration, high-complexity engagements; PMI standards and SPSM methodology are the dual frameworks this role enforces daily

Agile SCRUM Master certification

10+ years using and/or implementing the core Salesforce products (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud), ideally as a consultant, with a significant understanding of the Salesforce platform in order to influence strategic and value discussions at a management/executive level

Salesforce platform certifications (Admin, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing, etc.); these certifications will be a requirement as part of your role at Salesforce and are available through the global education reimbursement program

Health & Life Sciences domain expertise sufficient to credibly advise at the executive level on industry trends, regulatory considerations, and the strategic implications of technology transformation within the vertical

Experience operating in outcomes-based or fixed-fee delivery models where margin is set at the proposal and protected through execution discipline — not recouped through change orders after the fact

Demonstrated ability to negotiate and resolve conflict in a delivery context — including change order negotiation, scope dispute resolution, and steering committee decision-forcing

Additional Information

Possible travel of about 25%, but exact travel requirements will vary based on customer.

Bachelor's degree required

Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and   be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can   do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

The Experience

CSG(Customer Success Group)は、顧客を成功に導くことを最重要ミッションとしているSalesforce内の組織です。CSGはSalesforceのポストセールス部門の位置付けで、主にカスタマーサクセス、プロフェッショナルサービス、製品サポート、リニューアルの4部門で構成されています。

本ロールはCSGのプロフェッショナルサービス本部のオペレーション部門に所属し、プロジェクトのリスクマネジメントを実施するための、個別案件における契約相談、収益管理、コンプライアンス対応全般を担います。

日本地域のプロフェッショナルサービス(PS)部門のオペレーションを担うシニアマネージャー職です。大型構築案件のDeal Risk Assessment(商談リスク評価)プロセスを主導し、Global Services Deal Strategyチームと連携しながら、契約からデリバリー、収益認識までのエンドツーエンドで受託業務の品質と正確性を担保します。加えて、プライバシーマーク維持対応、BCP(事業継続計画)演習の推進、部門内AIツール利用ガバナンスの整備など部門運営全般にも幅広く関わり、リスクマネジメントとオペレーション両面から部門の成長に貢献します。

このロールの成功は、Deal Riskの適切な評価・低減とリーダーシップへの提言、個別案件における営業担当者への効果的な指導と受注支援、およびプロフェッショナルサービス部門の収益によって測られます。

部門のリスク管理全般における信頼されるアドバイザーとしての立ち位置を確立し、Sales・Delivery・Legal・Financeそして部門Leadershipが安心して相談できる窓口となることが求められます。分析・助言にとどまらず、個別案件の相談対応やステークホルダーへの啓発・教育まで幅広く自ら手を動かし、成果に責任を持つ実行力が不可欠です。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

- 大型構築案件のDeal Risk Assessmentをリード。Global Services Deal Strategy(DealStrat)チームの日本における委任先として、Risk Breakdown Structureに基づく低減策を整理し、部門Senior Leadershipへ判断材料(リスク評価、投資適格性、リソース・Staffing Plan・コスト見積りの実行可能性)を提供。DealStrat関連ポリシーの社内浸透・遵守状況の確認も担う
- 複雑・大型・交渉難易度の高い商談における契約建付けの相談対応、および営業担当者への交渉戦略支援(有償/無償スコープ分離、収益認識(ASC606)の理解に基づく収益計上への影響評価・助言)
- 無償の役務提供を含む投資案件について、Salesforce内規・法令遵守の観点で事前確認を実施。必要に応じLegal/EthicsやSenior Leadershipと協議し、判断結果を記録管理
- 個別案件におけるSecurity Checksheet対応、情報セキュリティ・個人データ保護に関する関係者調整や担当営業・プロジェクトチームへの指導
- プライバシーマーク維持のための社内対応・継続的な運用改善、および部門BCP(事業継続計画)演習への参加とそこから得た知見に基づく継続的な改善推進
- 部門内AIツールの利用ガバナンス整理(Global連携含む)と、リスク・コンプライアンス・AIツール利用等に関する社内イネーブルメントの実施
- ジュニアメンバーへのメンタリングとDeal Risk評価に関するナレッジ共有

You're Our Person If...

- 役務の提供に際し、契約とプロジェクトの建付けを論理的に整理・説明する力や高い倫理観(公平性・合理的必然性)
- 提案書レビューや契約審査の実務経験(業務委託契約書や収益認識の理解)
- PS/コンサルティング領域における6年以上の実務経験
- Deal Structuringにおける3年以上の実務経験
- 大規模構築案件のリスクアセスメント経験
- 複数ステークホルダー(Sales、Delivery、Legal、Finance、グローバルOps)との折衝・調整力
- 日本語・英語ビジネスレベル(Global連携のため必須)
- 正式な決裁権限がない中でも、複数ステークホルダーを巻き込み自律的に商談・案件を前進させる推進力

Even Better If...

- PMP (Project Management Professional)
- 情報セキュリティ/個人データ保護に関する実務知識
- 収益認識(ASC606)に関する基礎的な理解
- AIツールを活用した業務改善への意欲
- Salesforce製品知識・資格

The Experience

The Customer Success Group (CSG) is Salesforce's organization dedicated to driving customer success. As Salesforce's post-sales organization, CSG is composed primarily of four functions: Customer Success, Professional Services, Product Support, and Renewals.

This role sits within the Operations function of CSG's Professional Services organization, owning contract consultation, revenue management, and overall compliance support on individual engagements as part of project risk management.

This is a Senior Manager role responsible for Professional Services (PS) operations in the Japan region. The role leads the Deal Risk Assessment process for large-scale implementation engagements, partnering with the Global Services Deal Strategy team to ensure quality and accuracy end-to-end — from contracting through delivery to revenue recognition. The role also engages broadly in organizational operations, including maintaining Privacy Mark certification, driving BCP (business continuity plan) exercises, and establishing governance for AI tool usage within the organization — contributing to the organization's growth through both risk management and operations.

Success in this role is measured by appropriate assessment and mitigation of Deal Risk and recommendations to leadership, effective guidance to sales representatives and deal support on individual engagements, and the Professional Services organization's revenue.

This role is expected to establish itself as a trusted advisor across the organization's risk management, serving as a go-to point of contact that Sales, Delivery, Legal, Finance, and organizational Leadership can rely on. Beyond analysis and advisory, this requires hands-on execution — directly handling consultations on individual engagements and educating stakeholders — with ownership of outcomes.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

- Lead Deal Risk Assessment for large-scale implementation engagements. As the Japan delegate for the Global Services Deal Strategy (DealStrat) team, organize mitigation measures based on the Risk Breakdown Structure and provide decision-making input to organizational Senior Leadership (risk assessment, investment eligibility, feasibility of resources, staffing plan, and cost estimates). Also responsible for confirming internal adoption of and adherence to DealStrat-related policies
- Provide consultation on contract structuring for complex, large, or difficult-to-negotiate deals, and support sales representatives' negotiation strategy (separating paid/unpaid scope, assessing and advising on revenue recognition impact based on an understanding of ASC 606)
- Conduct advance review of investment deals involving unpaid services from the perspective of Salesforce internal policy and legal compliance. Consult with Legal/Ethics and Senior Leadership as needed, and maintain records of decisions
- Handle Security Checksheet responses on individual engagements, coordinate with stakeholders on information security and personal data protection, and guide the responsible sales rep and project team
- Support internal processes and continuous operational improvement for maintaining Privacy Mark certification, and participate in the organization's BCP (business continuity plan) exercises, driving continuous improvement based on learnings
- Organize governance for AI tool usage within the organization (including Global coordination), and conduct internal enablement on risk, compliance, and AI tool usage
- Mentor junior members and share knowledge on Deal Risk assessment

You're Our Person If...

- You have strong ethics (fairness and reasonable necessity) and the ability to logically organize and explain contract and project structuring in the delivery of services
- You have hands-on experience reviewing proposals and contracts (including an understanding of outsourcing agreements and revenue recognition)
- You have 6+ years of experience in Professional Services/Consulting
- You have 3+ years of experience in Deal Structuring
- You have experience with risk assessment on large-scale implementation engagements
- You have the ability to negotiate and coordinate with multiple stakeholders (Sales, Delivery, Legal, Finance, Global Ops)
- You have business-level Japanese and English (required for Global coordination)
- You have the drive to independently move deals and engagements forward by involving multiple stakeholders, even without formal decision-making authority

Even Better If...

- PMP (Project Management Professional)
- Practical knowledge of information security/personal data protection
- Basic understanding of revenue recognition (ASC 606)
- Enthusiasm for improving work processes using AI tools
- Salesforce product knowledge/certifications

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Overview
AI is reshaping how capital is deployed, how companies scale, and how value is created, and nowhere is that shift moving faster than in private equity and the startup ecosystem. The Global Private Equity & Startups Practice (PE & Startups) is one of Salesforce's most strategic go-to-market initiatives. We partner with the world's leading PE firms, their portfolio companies, and the most ambitious high-growth and AI-native startups to help them become agentic enterprises.
As a Solution Engineer in PE & Startups, you'll work where enterprise technology, investment strategy, and executive advisory meet. You'll help investors and operators turn AI from a boardroom talking point into measurable results, using Agentforce, Data 360, and the Salesforce platform to redesign how deals are sourced, how portfolios are run, and how companies grow.
This is not a traditional SE role. You'll advise Operating Partners, founders, and C-suite leaders, build solution narratives that move at deal speed, and help define what an AI-first operating model looks like across entire portfolios.
Why This Role Stands Out
You'll be at the forefront of agentic AI adoption. PE firms are under pressure to show AI-driven value creation across their portfolios, and startups are building AI into their businesses from day one. You'll help both.
You'll have outsized, portfolio-level impact. One successful engagement with a PE firm can shape the technology strategy of dozens of portfolio companies. One win with a fast-growing startup can grow into a long-term enterprise partnership.
You'll work with sophisticated, fast-moving leaders: Managing Partners, Operating Partners, founders, CFOs, CROs, and CIOs who expect sharp thinking and fast results.
You'll join a specialized, high-visibility team aligned to Salesforce's most strategic PE-backed and high-growth accounts, and you'll help shape the practice's point of view on AI in private markets.
What You'll Do
Advise on agentic transformation. Serve as the primary technical and strategic advisor to PE firms, their portfolio companies, and high-growth startups, guiding them through multi-cloud Salesforce and Agentforce solutions for deal flow, LP relations, portfolio operations, and revenue growth.
Lead executive conversations. Run discovery and value-framing sessions with Managing Directors, Operating Partners, founders, CFOs, and CIOs, connecting AI and data strategy directly to investment theses, EBITDA improvement, and growth goals.
Show the future, not slides. Design and deliver highly tailored demos, prototypes, and proofs of concept that show AI agents working alongside people: automating sourcing and diligence workflows, improving portfolio visibility, scaling sales and service, and unlocking digital labor.
Drive portfolio-wide value creation. Articulate how Salesforce accelerates revenue growth, operational efficiency, and exit readiness, and help firms build repeatable AI and data playbooks they can roll out across their portfolios.
Partner with startups built for scale. Help AI-native and venture-backed companies build a platform that grows with them, from early go-to-market motions to enterprise-grade operations.
Orchestrate the best of Salesforce. Work with the PE & Startups Relationship Management team on account strategy, executive mapping, and deal orchestration, and bring in specialists (industry SEs, solution architects, Agentforce and Data 360 experts) where they add the most value.
Stay ahead of the curve. Build deep expertise in Agentforce, Data 360, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Slack, Tableau, and MuleSoft, and track how agentic AI, data strategy, and AI governance are changing private markets and scaling companies.
Shape thought leadership. Co-create point-of-view assets, reference architectures, demo environments, and enablement content for PE & Startups personas, including emerging use cases such as AI-assisted due diligence, portfolio intelligence, and agent-powered go-to-market.
Be the face of Salesforce in the ecosystem. Represent Salesforce at high-profile PE & Startups events, operating partner summits, founder forums, roundtables, and executive dinners.
Elevate the broader SE community. Mentor and enable fellow SEs on PE & Startups narratives, methods, and AI-driven deal approaches.
Keep learning. Maintain relevant certifications and stay current on Salesforce innovation, AI market developments, and private markets trends.
Travel as needed to engage PE firm headquarters, portfolio company sites, and startup hubs across the US.
What You'll Bring
A strong track record in technical pre-sales, solution engineering, or solution consulting for enterprise software, ideally with executive-facing engagements
Business acumen and financial fluency: you understand how PE firms create value, how startups scale, and how technology decisions affect EBITDA, growth, and valuation
Hands-on curiosity about generative and agentic AI, and the ability to explain clearly where AI agents create real business value and where they don't
Confidence and credibility with senior investors, operators, and founders, and the ability to run complex, multi-stakeholder conversations on tight timelines
Strong storytelling, demo, and whiteboarding skills
Experience with Salesforce, CRM, data platforms, or AI solutions is a strong plus; experience in or alongside private equity, venture-backed companies, or financial services is highly valued
We hire based on demonstrated expertise and impact. If you're excited about helping the world's leading investors and fastest-growing companies make the leap to agentic AI, we'd love to hear from you.

At the more tactical level, this role is designed to lead and manage an AMER Services operating unit portfolio in its entirety - driving utilization, bookings, and revenue across the OU. You will work cross functionally with our sales teams to ensure GTM motions are integrated to drive end-to-end success for our customers. This role will also partner on the development of new industry-specific Services products and programs, based on insightful customer engagement and understanding, including launching pilots that will allow us to co-create new offerings with our customers to confirm market fit — with a bias toward AI-powered delivery accelerators and agent-driven service models.

- Strategic Thinker: Ability to translate details into bigger picture implications driving the business forward, challenging the status quo. Understands industry, market and organizational dynamics with the intellectual horse-power to handle growing complexity and ambiguity. Aligns the right resources to the task at hand; foresees and plans around obstacles.

- Talent Management: Has a passion for building great teams - proven ability to develop others who have significantly contributed to company success with a history of making good hiring decisions and developing a strong bench of successors. Champions talent beyond own organization.

- Innovate for Growth: Always thinking about how to make improvements; able to implement changes that map to business strategy. Stays abreast of cutting edge technology trends.

- AI-Forward Mindset: Genuinely curious about and fluent in how AI and agentic technology are reshaping services delivery. Champions the shift to an AI Native delivery model — pushing the team to rethink processes, staffing, and offer design around AI-augmented and AI-led work rather than simply layering AI on top of legacy methods.

- Focus on Customer Success: Builds and maintains relationships with customers; shapes solutions that have significant positive impact on their business.

- Builds Trust and Credibility: Makes decisions based on organization's values - actions are consistent with company's core values. Ability to set clear vision - role models a growth mindset and shares mistakes widely for others to benefit and embraces a learning mentality.

- Lead & Adapt to Change: Thrives in a changing, dynamic environment - Relishes leading even when times are tough and models the attributes of a GREAT leader. Comfortable driving organizational and operational transformation at pace, and bringing skeptical teams along on the journey.

- Courageous Communicator: Must be able to take an unpopular stand if necessary for the betterment of our business. Must encourage a transparent and healthy debate while seeking the best alternative. This leader is looked to for direction in a crisis, faces adversity head on, and is energized by tough challenges.

- 15+ years experience in a Services leadership position with proven quota attainment and exceptional results building, managing success, bookings, revenue and margin while growing an annual business portfolio of $250M+.

jobs.title: VP, Global Compensation
jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category
Employee Success
Job Details

About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

AI is changing the content of work, the pace at which skills gain and lose value, and the standard for how People teams operate. Compensation has to keep up without losing clarity, fairness, or financial discipline. Salesforce is looking for a U.S.-based senior leader who can build that balance into the architecture, programs, and operating practices that support a global workforce.

The Vice President, Global Compensation will own Salesforce's worldwide broad-based compensation strategy, architecture, and governance, including U.S. delivery. This leader will connect business and talent strategy to global job architecture, salary structures, geographic pay, annual compensation programs, pay equity and transparency, analytics, and the global compensation workstream for acquisitions.

The role combines enterprise ownership of broad-based compensation with strong partnership across Executive & Equity Compensation, Global Benefits, Global Incentive Compensation, Finance, Legal, Tax, Payroll, Stock Administration, People Analytics, Talent, Employee Relations, and business leadership.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Set worldwide strategy and governance:
- Define the global compensation philosophy. Translate business strategy, workforce priorities, and talent-market realities into durable principles for how Salesforce pays across the United States and international markets.
- Build practical governance. Establish enterprise standards, decision rights, policy ownership, approval thresholds, and documented exception paths that preserve global coherence while allowing justified local variation.
- Shape enterprise and Board-level decisions. Prepare decision-quality analysis and materials for the C-suite, People leadership, and relevant governance bodies; present clear alternatives and explicit cost, talent, risk, and employee-impact tradeoffs while respecting formal approval authorities.

Architect jobs and pay globally:
- Own the global job architecture. Maintain job families, career streams, levels, profiles, and evaluation standards that support career clarity, workforce planning, organization design, and consistent pay decisions.
- Design scalable pay structures. Set salary ranges, market-positioning principles, geographic differentials, and refresh cadences for selected U.S. and international labor markets; use reputable surveys and Legal-approved market-data protocols.
- Respond to changing skill value. Identify critical-skill and labor-market signals, evaluate targeted premiums or differentiated approaches, and manage internal equity and compression implications.

Lead global compensation programs:
- Run the annual compensation agenda. Own worldwide design and governance of salary, merit, promotion, and broad-based bonus programs, including U.S. execution, budgets, systems requirements, calibration, controls, manager guidance, and employee communications.
- Manage total direct compensation coherently. Connect base pay and broad-based incentives with equity strategy through close partnership with Executive & Equity Compensation, Finance, Tax, Legal, and Stock Administration.
- Maintain the global policy suite. Govern pay decisions for hiring, promotions, transfers, off-cycle adjustments, geographic moves, and retention situations with clear principles and usable tools.

Advance pay equity and transparency:
- Build objective pay practices. Embed documented, job-related criteria into job evaluation, range design, offers, movement, and annual pay decisions.
- Lead global pay-equity analytics. Develop recurring analyses, remediation scenarios, and execution governance; support counsel-directed reviews and keep legal conclusions and privilege decisions with Legal.
- Operate across the U.S. regulatory mosaic. Own the range architecture, geographic-pay inputs, data, and operating controls that enable recruiting and People teams to meet evolving federal, state, and local pay-transparency and reporting requirements.
- Set the global transparency framework. Translate candidate, employee, and reporting requirements across jurisdictions into scalable processes, manager tools, and communications.

Turn data into enterprise decisions:
- Model the choices. Build multi-year forecasts and scenarios that show the cost, market, talent, equity, compression, currency, and implementation effects of major compensation decisions.
- Strengthen the data foundation. Set global standards for compensation data quality, definitions, access, controls, and lineage across planning, market pricing, reporting, and decision support.

Build the future of compensation:
- Translate changes in work into pay implications. Partner with Future of Work, Talent, Workforce Strategy, and People Analytics teams to understand how AI changes tasks, roles, skills, career paths, and talent scarcity.

- Apply AI responsibly. Use governed AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve market pricing, scenario modeling, cycle operations, anomaly detection, and advisory support. Validate data and model quality, document material assumptions, protect confidential data, monitor for discriminatory outcomes, and preserve accountable human judgment.

Lead compensation through acquisitions and change:

- Create an executable integration path. Define decision points, transition principles, milestones, communications, and exception governance in partnership with Rewards, Finance, Legal, Tax, Payroll, Mobility, and Employee Relations.

Build the team and enterprise capability:
- Lead a high-performing global function. Build a diverse, succession-ready team of compensation partners with strong technical depth, business judgment, and regional credibility.
- Raise compensation capability. Equip People Partners, recruiters, managers, and leaders with clear guidance, decision tools, and training that improve the quality and consistency of pay decisions.
- Create trust through clarity. Explain complex choices in plain language, surface tradeoffs early, and maintain strong relationships across regions, functions, and levels.

You're Our Person If...

- Enterprise compensation leadership. 15+ years of progressive compensation or Total Rewards experience, including leadership of complex, multi-country programs and high-performing teams.
- Broad-based depth. Demonstrated expertise in compensation philosophy, job architecture, market pricing, salary structures, geographic pay, annual salary and incentive cycles, and program governance.
- Business and financial judgment. Ability to connect talent choices to business strategy and model cost, workforce, market, equity, compression, and implementation tradeoffs with Finance.
- Fairness and transparency. Experience building objective pay-setting frameworks, leading pay-equity analytics and remediation planning, and operationalizing pay-transparency requirements with Legal and People partners.
- Data and technology fluency. Strong command of compensation data, advanced analytics, scenario modeling, visualization, HR systems, and the controls required to produce reliable decision support.
- Responsible AI practice. Evidence of moving an AI or automation use case from experiment to controlled production with measurable improvement in accuracy, cycle time, controls, capacity, or user experience.
- Transformation experience. A record of modernizing compensation programs or operating models, leading through ambiguity, and delivering change that managers and employees can understand and use.
- M&A capability. Experience with compensation diligence, employee and role mapping, retention arrangements, harmonization, cost modeling, and integration governance.
- Executive influence. Credibility with C-suite leaders and senior People, Finance, Legal, and business stakeholders; able to turn technical detail into clear choices and recommendations.
- Cross-functional fluency. Working knowledge of executive and equity compensation, broad-based equity, sales incentives, benefits, mobility, tax, payroll, and accounting sufficient to lead across specialist boundaries.
- U.S. and global fluency. Experience operating in a changing U.S. federal, state, and local environment and across multiple international markets, with the judgment to engage counsel early.
- Public-company interface. Working fluency in executive and equity compensation governance, SEC disclosure context, and share-based-payment cost considerations; specialist filing, accounting, tax, and approval authority remains with the relevant functions.
- Education. Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree or relevant professional certification is welcomed.

- Coherent global architecture. Jobs, levels, and pay structures have defined coverage, ownership, and refresh cadences across selected labor markets.

- Precise and practical. You turn ambiguity into clear principles, decision rights, and operating mechanisms.
- Curious without chasing novelty. You test promising ideas, define evidence up front, and scale only what works.
- Candid and low ego. You challenge constructively, explain tradeoffs plainly, and change course when the evidence changes.

jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category
Employee Success
Job Details

About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The opportunity

AI is changing the content of work, the pace at which skills gain and lose value, and the standard for how People teams operate. Compensation has to keep up without losing clarity, fairness, local credibility, or financial discipline. Salesforce is looking for a Dublin-based senior leader who can build that balance into the architecture, programs, and operating practices that support employees across international markets.
The Vice President, International Compensation will own Salesforce's broad-based compensation strategy and advisory agenda for markets outside the United States. This leader will translate enterprise rewards principles into locally relevant, scalable programs and bring international market, regulatory, and employee insight into enterprise compensation decisions.
This is an enterprise leadership role with a direct remit focused on international compensation. It combines clear ownership with strong partnership across Executive & Equity Compensation, Global Benefits, Global Incentive Compensation, Finance, Legal, Privacy, Tax, Payroll, Stock Administration, Mobility, People Analytics, Talent, Employee Relations, and business leadership.

What you'll own
Set international strategy and governance
- Define the international compensation agenda. Translate enterprise philosophy, business strategy, and workforce priorities into clear principles and priorities for markets outside the United States.

- Build practical governance. Establish international standards, decision rights, policy ownership, approval thresholds, and documented exception paths that preserve enterprise coherence while allowing justified local variation.

- Bring international insight to enterprise decisions. Advise senior People and business leaders with concise analysis, clear alternatives, and explicit market, cost, regulatory, employee, and implementation tradeoffs.

Architect jobs and pay across international markets
- Lead the international application of job architecture. Maintain consistent job evaluation, career streams, levels, and profiles across markets and surface local evidence that should influence enterprise architecture.

- Design locally credible pay structures. Own international salary ranges, market-positioning principles, geographic differentials, and refresh cadences for selected labor markets; use reputable surveys and approved market-data protocols.

- Respond to market and currency change. Monitor labor-market, inflation, and currency signals and establish range-review and foreign-exchange methodologies with Finance and local People teams rather than relying on automatic indexing.

- Respond to changing skill value. Identify critical-skill and talent-market signals, evaluate targeted premiums or differentiated approaches, and manage internal equity and compression implications.

Lead international compensation programs
- Run the international annual agenda. Own the design adaptation, governance, and delivery of salary, merit, promotion, and broad-based bonus programs outside the United States, including budgets, systems requirements, calibration, controls, manager guidance, and employee communications.

- Manage total direct compensation coherently. Connect international base pay and broad-based incentives with equity strategy through close partnership with Executive & Equity Compensation, Finance, Tax, Legal, Payroll, and Stock Administration.

- Maintain international policies. Govern pay decisions for hiring, promotions, transfers, off-cycle adjustments, cross-border moves, and retention situations with clear principles and usable tools.

- Partner on mobility. Shape assignment compensation, allowances, differentials, and tax-equalization principles with Mobility, Tax, Payroll, Finance, and Legal.

Advance international pay equity and transparency
- Build objective, gender-neutral pay practices. Embed documented criteria into job evaluation, range design, offers, movement, and annual pay decisions, including the factors used to assess equal work or work of equal value.

- Lead recurring pay-equity analytics. Develop reliable analyses, remediation scenarios, and execution governance; support counsel-directed reviews and keep legal conclusions and privilege decisions with Legal.

- Lead transparency readiness. Translate the EU Pay Transparency Directive, applicable national implementing laws, and other international requirements into compensation structures, data, reporting, processes, manager tools, and communications.

- Keep reporting disciplines distinct. Support Irish and other statutory gender-pay-gap reporting while maintaining a clear distinction between population-level reporting, equal-pay analysis, and market competitiveness.

- Support employee-representation processes. Provide compensation analysis, design rationale, and implementation scenarios for European and local information or consultation processes where required.

Turn international data into decisions
- Model the choices. Build multi-year forecasts and scenarios that show the cost, market, talent, equity, compression, currency, and implementation effects of major compensation decisions.

- Strengthen the data foundation. Set standards for compensation data quality, definitions, access, controls, retention, and cross-border use in partnership with Privacy, Legal, HR Technology, and People Analytics.

- Measure what matters. Create a focused scorecard for program competitiveness, internal consistency, cycle accuracy and timeliness, budget performance, exception patterns, adoption, and operating efficiency.

Build the future of international compensation
- Translate changes in work into pay implications. Partner with Future of Work, Talent, Workforce Strategy, and People Analytics teams to understand how AI changes tasks, roles, skills, career paths, and talent scarcity across international markets.

- Run disciplined experiments. Test skills-based pay, targeted skill premiums, and new approaches to AI-affected roles through defined hypotheses, local-law and employee-relations guardrails, success measures, and controlled pilots before scaling.

- Apply AI responsibly. Use governed AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve market pricing, scenario modeling, cycle operations, anomaly detection, and advisory support. Validate data and model quality, document material assumptions, protect confidential data, assess privacy impact, monitor for discriminatory outcomes, and preserve accountable human judgment.

Lead international compensation through acquisitions and change
- Lead the international compensation workstream for M&A. Own diligence, job and employee mapping, acquired-company pay and incentive assessment, retention arrangements, harmonization options, and cost and risk modeling outside the United States.

- Create an executable transition path. Define decision points, transition principles, milestones, communications, and exception governance in partnership with Rewards, Finance, Legal, Tax, Payroll, Mobility, Privacy, and Employee Relations.

Build the team and international capability
- Lead a high-performing international function. Build a diverse, succession-ready team of compensation partners with strong technical depth, business judgment, and local credibility.

- Raise compensation capability. Equip People Partners, recruiters, managers, and leaders with clear guidance, decision tools, and training that improve the quality and consistency of pay decisions.

- Create trust through clarity. Explain complex choices in plain language, surface tradeoffs early, and maintain strong relationships across countries, functions, and levels.

What success looks like
- Clear international governance. Leaders understand enterprise principles, international decision rights, and exception paths, and material decisions are documented and repeatable.

- Locally credible architecture. International jobs, levels, and pay structures have defined coverage, ownership, and refresh cadences and reflect selected labor markets without losing enterprise coherence.

- Reliable delivery. International annual compensation cycles are accurate, on time, within approved budgets, and supported by locally usable manager and employee communications.

- Regulatory readiness. Pay-equity routines, transparency processes, statutory reporting inputs, and employee-representation support operate with reliable data and the appropriate Legal, Privacy, and Employee Relations review.

- Better decisions. Senior leaders use clear international scenario analysis to make informed tradeoffs, and acquisition compensation milestones move from diligence through integration.

- Measured modernization. Controlled technology and AI use cases reduce manual work or error, improve cycle time or insight quality, and maintain privacy, control, and human accountability.

- Stronger capability. The international compensation team, People Partners, recruiters, and managers can apply compensation principles with greater consistency and local credibility.

What you'll bring
- International compensation leadership. 15+ years of progressive compensation or Total Rewards experience, including leadership of complex programs and high-performing teams across multiple markets outside the United States.

- Broad-based depth. Demonstrated expertise in compensation philosophy, job architecture, market pricing, salary structures, geographic pay, annual salary and incentive cycles, and program governance.

- Cross-border fluency. Experience navigating materially different labor markets, currencies, employment frameworks, and employee-representation environments across Europe and other international regions.

- Fairness and transparency. Experience with objective job evaluation, pay-equity analytics and remediation planning, pay-transparency readiness, and statutory gender-pay-gap reporting in partnership with Legal and specialist teams.

- Business and financial judgment. Ability to connect talent choices to business strategy and model cost, workforce, market, equity, compression, inflation, currency, and implementation tradeoffs with Finance.

- Data, privacy, and technology fluency. Strong command of compensation data, advanced analytics, scenario modeling, visualization, HR systems, and privacy-aware controls for international decision support.

- Responsible AI practice. Evidence of moving an AI or automation use case from experiment to controlled production with measurable improvement in accuracy, cycle time, controls, capacity, or user experience.

- Transformation and consultation experience. A record of modernizing compensation programs and delivering change through local People teams and, where applicable, works councils or other employee representatives.

- M&A capability. Experience with international compensation diligence, employee and role mapping, retention arrangements, harmonization, cost modeling, and integration governance.

- Executive influence. Credibility with senior People, Finance, Legal, and business stakeholders; able to turn technical and jurisdictional detail into clear choices and recommendations.

- Cross-functional fluency. Working knowledge of executive and equity compensation, broad-based equity, sales incentives, benefits, mobility, tax, payroll, and accounting sufficient to lead across specialist boundaries.

- Education. Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree or relevant professional certification is welcomed.

How you lead
- Precise and practical. You turn ambiguity into clear principles, decision rights, and operating mechanisms.

- Curious without chasing novelty. You test promising ideas, define evidence up front, and scale only what works.

- Candid and low ego. You challenge constructively, explain tradeoffs plainly, and change course when the evidence changes.

- Human-centered and accountable. You understand that pay decisions affect trust and opportunity, and you pair innovation with disciplined judgment.

- Calm under pressure. You can lead high-stakes annual cycles, executive decisions, and transformation work without losing rigor or perspective.

Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and   be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can   do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. - Broad Relationship Building: Build strong relationships and influence a broad set of stakeholders across the company, including Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Partners, Finance, Product, and Business Technology

- Experience: 6+ years of experience in strategy and transformation in GTM, Sales, Customer Success, and/or Professional Services at a top strategy consulting firm or high-growth SaaS company; exposure to B2B GTM strategy preferred
- Education: BS/BA degree or equivalent experience; MBA preferred but not required
- Strategic & Analytical Acumen: Strong combination of strategic thinking and data analysis / logical reasoning skills, with experience developing models and analyzing complex datasets using Excel ( SQL , Claude , and Tableau are a plus). Able to utilize analysis to identify business insights and form actionable recommendations.
- Leadership & Influence: Demonstrated experience leading and working with cross-functional leaders, often in a matrixed environment. Ability to influence and align executive and senior stakeholders, demonstrating high EQ and tact while influencing and navigating productively through conflict.
- Managing Ambiguity: Ability to lead effectively through a high degree of change, demonstrating consistent ability to prioritize, cut through noise, and execute through ambiguity. Comfortable working with limited information.
- Communication Excellence: Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, including experience in leading high-level business discussions with senior leaders and developing executive-friendly decks conveying actionable insights.

Is consistently accurate and delivers high-quality work in fast-paced dynamic environments. Demonstrates grit in the face of challenges and knows how to effectively use resources to achieve goals.
